Find the body, reservoir, and universe entropy changes.
questions.answer:
Model:

Working:
Equation \([1]\) gives \[\Delta S=200\ln(400/300)=57.54\,\mathrm{J\,K^{-1}}.\] The heat received is \(Q=200(400-300)=2.00\times10^4\,\mathrm{J}\). Equation \([2]\) gives \[\Delta S_{\mathrm{res}}=-\frac{2.00\times10^4}{400}=-50.00\,\mathrm{J\,K^{-1}}.\] Adding the two, consistently with equation \([3]\), gives \(\Delta S_{\mathrm{univ}}=7.54\,\mathrm{J\,K^{-1}}\gt 0\). Final result: \(\Delta S=57.54\,\mathrm{J\,K^{-1}}\), \(\Delta S_{\mathrm{res}}=-50.00\,\mathrm{J\,K^{-1}}\), and \(\Delta S_{\mathrm{univ}}=7.54\,\mathrm{J\,K^{-1}}\).

Final answer:
\(\Delta S=57.54\,\mathrm{J\,K^{-1}}\), \(\Delta S_{\mathrm{res}}=-50.00\,\mathrm{J\,K^{-1}}\), and \(\Delta S_{\mathrm{univ}}=7.54\,\mathrm{J\,K^{-1}}\).
